The rally will begin with a march from Minto Road to Ramlila Maidan, followed by speeches by senior opposition leaders. With organisers expecting a large turnout, Delhi Police have deployed over 4,000 personnel and more than 200 CCTV cameras to monitor the venue. Our reporters Anshul Singh and Shambhavi Srivastava are on the ground at Ramlila Maidan, bringing you the latest developments from the rally, while Rahul Gautam is tracking the action from Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge's residence and Shreya Chatterjee from Minto Road. Stay tuned to IndiaToday.in for live updates, ground reports and minute-by-minute developments.
